era.rule: this adjudication is void on any change to the fingerprint, readout or differential hash above, and must be mechanically re-derived rather than carried forward
era.rederived_at_this_era_by: reports/c46_trick_attacker_item_gap.json -- branch-set measurement re-run at fingerprint d739faa2, identical 74 rows

of_which_certification_relevant: part of the 485 unattributed rows on the C32 sweep population
evidence_chain_by_the_c27_method: C37: enumerated the engine's real branch set with generate_instructions on each row's own states. 74 of 179 have NO branch reaching the observed net HP delta. The test is asymmetric -- decisive in the negative, only suggestive in the positive -- so exactly these 74 are claimed.

C39: excluded roll collapse as the explanation. The engine emits 1-3 distinct deltas per boundary because DamageRolls is Average|Min|Max (damage_calc.rs:39); an Average branch sits at ~92.5% so real rolls land within +/-8.1%. All 66 measurable rows are beyond 18% from the closest branch, median 44% off.
C39: excluded a Sleep Talk mechanism. The non-Sleep-Talk control has an indistinguishable failure profile (20/7/9/1 vs 17/10/9/1).
C38: excluded partial observability. 24 of 37 Sleep Talk rows called a move the engine demonstrably knows; 5 more were a normalizer artifact (HIDDENPOWERICE70).
C41: excluded a lethality-pricing defect. On mirror-symmetric thresholds 5 vs 1 at n=6 (p=0.109), Brier 0.066.

C42: CONFIRMED search relevance against a control. n-hit-KO threshold shift is 75.7% on the support gaps against a 22.1% baseline on matched boundaries (n=642 slot-observations from 400 sampled matched rows) -- a 3.4x elevation.

adjudication.verdict: REAL, SEARCH-RELEVANT, AND NOT FIXABLE AS A SINGLE DEFECT AT THIS ERA.
adjudication.real: 74 transitions the simulator reaches are outside the engine's enumerated support, with four independent alternative explanations tested and excluded
adjudication.search_relevant: shifts the n-hit-KO threshold at 3.4x the matched-boundary rate; this is the term objective 4's ranking formula needs and it is nonzero
adjudication.not_a_single_defect: the population is heterogeneous -- roughly half have every engine branch smaller than observed, a quarter larger, a quarter bracket it, one is a turn the engine thinks did not happen. No mechanism spans them.
adjudication.instrument_baseline_disclosed: the 22.1% matched-boundary shift rate is instrument noise from roll collapse, not engine error. Any future claim on this measure must be read against that floor, not against zero.

why_no_fix_is_registered: Objective 4 requires each fix to be pre-registered with the tactics-suite gate. A registration needs a scoped mechanism and a predicted row delta. This bucket has neither: no mechanism survived testing, and with the population heterogeneous any patch would be scoped to a shape rather than a cause. Registering a fix without a mechanism would violate the prediction-first discipline the whole program rests on. The correct output is this adjudication, not a speculative patch.
regression_gate_state: tests/test_search_depth_tactics.py -- 5 tests, GREEN at this era. Baseline recorded so any future patch against this bucket has a pre-fix reference.
what_would_reopen_this: any change to the era stamp above -- mandatory mechanical re-derivation
a mechanism that spans one of the sub-shapes (engine-smaller n=37, engine-larger n=17, bracketing n=18), which would make that sub-shape registrable on its own

does_not_reach_a_pass: This adjudicates the engine-gap bucket. It does not certify. 485 rows remain unattributed against a required zero, and certification additionally needs the coverage shortfall (0.9587 vs 0.97) and the family-bound/class-set recalibration, neither of which any cycle from C35 to C42 touched.
